name: Scheduled-release and breaking-news latency taking (earnings, macro prints, agency / court decisions, election-night returns, live ceremonies)
maturity: Established (tiny capacity, winner-take-all); sub-variants other than earnings are Emerging / unverified
one_line: Sweep resting orders that nobody cancelled in the first hundreds of milliseconds after a scheduled or breaking public fact; the list has this for crypto, sports, weather and mentions but not for the generic news case.
scope: Cover the non-crypto, non-sports version of latency taking, which no entry in the list owns. (1) Scheduled releases: 'Will X beat earnings' markets (observed sniper wallet ~$32k 'near risk-free', wins 100% because 'many people forget to cancel their orders before the announcement'; challenger with a ~500 ms wire feed found the book 'swept before we receive the wires' and only won on EPS-definition ambiguity or when the leader hit size limits), macro prints and Fed decisions, agency / court publication times. (2) Unscheduled headlines from X / Truth Social / Telegram / wires (arXiv 2605.21521: X and news roughly tied on 109 Polymarket events, abstract-level). (3) Election-night returns models and live award ceremonies with stream delay: no PnL evidence found this session, mark unverified. (4) The maker-side mirror, which matters more to this owner: a release-calendar cancel / widen module for the LP bot, since the prey is exactly un-cancelled maker quotes. Include the 250 ms finance taker delay (pending, non-cancellable), fee 0.04-0.05 x p(1-p) being negligible at post-news extreme prices, capacity = resting stale size only, SDK pre-trade network checks and second-granularity match timestamps as measurement limits. Boundary: crypto spot-lead is short-crypto-latency-taker; in-play sports is sports-automated-takers; station readings are weather-markets; transcript sniping is recurring-count-mention-markets; LLM interpretation of news is speculative band; MNPI is informed-flow-and-insider-trading.
why_it_matters: The owner's LP and resolution-sniping bots are the counterparty of this strategy today, and no file in the band tells them so. It is also the only entry that gives the Economics and Finance-earnings categories a home in the established band (macro nowcasting was sent to speculative). IMDEA's genesis-window study adds a useful nuance: economy markets have the widest opening spreads but low adverse selection because events are scheduled releases, so the risk is concentrated in the release second, which a calendar solves. A small team will not win the pure speed race on earnings (already lost by a team with a 500 ms feed) but can win on long-tail scheduled releases nobody watches and on definitional ambiguity.
flags: Public-information speed trading is permitted (E9 traffic-light table). Licensed newswire / data redistribution terms apply. Anything sourced from an embargo breach or an insider is MNPI and belongs to the flagged insider entry.
